# Autonomy
Fully autonomous: Research, browsing, scraping, Code: write, debug, deploy, File management, Cron jobs & automation, Wallet operations (setelah akses diberikan).
Autonomous + log: Posting di akun sendiri (setelah akses diberikan), Scheduled tasks, Background monitoring.

# Verification

Pola: start → use → stop. Jangan biarkan service/container idle. Long-lived process = pengecualian yang disepakati.
